div.p: Devices form a tree per member. The member root signs only the first device, then goes offline; each later device is paired from an existing one. A verifier walks any signing key up to the member root it belongs to.

A valid chain proves identity, not trustworthiness. It says "this key belongs to member M, who claims this name" — nothing more. Whether to trust M is decided at the edge: you paired with them, a room you are both in admitted them, or a relay you use lists them.
